newsitem.title: USA: First Union says Duke to manage energy use.
newsitem.headline: First Union says Duke to manage energy use.

text.p: First Union Corp said it signed a three-year energy management agreement with Duke Power Co affiliates Duke/Louis Dreyfus and Duke Engineering & Services that will save it millions of dollars.

First Union said Duke/Louis Dreyfus and Duke Engineering will work with First Union facilities to ensure cost-effective and reliable energy supplies and implement systems to optimize and control energy use, as well as help First Union realize administrative savings.

Duke/Louis Dreyfus and Duke Engineering will also negotiate bulk power purchases on behalf of First Union throughout its operations on the East Coast, which cover 12 states and the District of Columbia.
Tom Dorsey, vice president of First Union's Corporate Real Estate Division, said in a statement that the agreement promises to save the bank several million dollars.
First Union, a $139.9 billion-asset bank holding company headquartered in Charlotte, N.C., said the agreement was the first of its kind in the banking industry.
